# Tesla's new CFO is Indian-origin Vaibhav Taneja. Know his educational qualifications, net worth & more
Vaibhav Taneja holds a bachelor's degree in Commerce from Delhi University
![](https://assets.gqindia.com/photos/662f4e663a3c145ad3e9baa4/1:1/w_90%2Cc_limit/Gaurav%2520Sonavane.jpg)
By [Gaurav Sonavane](https://www.gqindia.com/profile/gaurav-sonavane)
8 August 2023
![Tesla's new CFO Vaibhav Taneja](https://assets.gqindia.com/photos/64d2067455d9445b48560d4c/16:9/w_2560%2Cc_limit/Tesla's-new-CFO-Vaibhav-Taneja.jpg)
Vaibhav Taneja, an Indian-origin executive has been appointed as [Tesla](https://www.gqindia.com/content/tesla-will-be-in-india-as-soon-as-humanly-possible-says-the-worlds-richest-man-elon-musk)'s new Chief Financial Officer (CFO). Zachary Kirkhorn, who held the position for four years at the US-based electric vehicle company, confirmed the news in a LinkedIn post on Monday. "_This morning Tesla announced that I've stepped down from my role as Chief Financial Officer, succeeded by our Chief Accounting Officer, Vaibhav Taneja,_ " Kirkhorn wrote.
While Tesla is yet to share the reason behind the change, Kirkhorn is reported to continue as the company's CFO till the end of the year. Talking about his journey at Tesla, Kirkhorn wrote, "_Being a part of this company is a special experience, and I'm extremely proud of the work we've done together since I joined over 13 years ago. As I shift my responsibilities to support this transition, I want to thank the talented, passionate, and hard-working employees at Tesla, who have accomplished things many thought (were) not possible._ " Furthermore, he also thanked [Elon Musk](https://www.gqindia.com/get-smart/content/5-things-elon-musk-did-to-become-one-of-the-richest-men-in-the-world) for his inspirational leadership. "_I also want to thank Elon for his leadership and optimism, which has inspired so many people,_ " Kirkhorn added.
Responding to the news, Musk expressed his gratitude to Kirkhorn and his contributions to [Tesla](https://www.gqindia.com/get-smart/content/elon-musk-loses-a-massive-personal-fortune-worth-rs-16-lakh-27-thousand-cr-this-is-his-present-net-worth). "_I would like to thank Zach Kirkhorn for his many contributions to Tesla over the course of 13 often difficult years. Much appreciated and best wishes for the next stage of his career,_ " Musk wrote on X.
#### X content
This content can also be viewed on the site it [originates](https://twitter.com/elonmusk/status/1688662299857321984) from.
Kirkhorn's more-than-a-decade-long tenure at Tesla has been described as a 'tremendous expansion and growth' phase in the company filing. Taneja who is currently the Chief Accounting Officer (CAO) at Tesla, will take over the additional responsibility of CFO soon. Here's everything that you need to know about Tesla's new Indian-origin CFO.

## Indian-origin Vaibhav Taneja appointed Tesla's new Chief Financial Officer. Here's everything you need to know about him
Education
[](https://www.gqindia.com/content/these-are-the-four-indian-americans-who-are-running-for-president-of-the-us-in-the-2024-elections)
[These are the four Indian Americans who are running for President of the US in the 2024 elections](https://www.gqindia.com/content/these-are-the-four-indian-americans-who-are-running-for-president-of-the-us-in-the-2024-elections)
By Umaima Saeed
Tesla's new Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Vaibhav Taneja hails from [India](https://www.gqindia.com/content/darjeeling-kodaikanal-and-other-perfect-places-in-india-to-visit-this-monsoon-and-bring-out-your-creative-side). According to the company's official website, he is a Certified Public Accountant, who also holds a bachelor's degree in Commerce from [Delhi](https://www.gqindia.com/entertainment/content/shark-tank-india-season-2-judge-aman-gupta-luxurious-lifestyle-lavish-bungalow-in-delhi-more) University.
Previous experience
According to his LinkedIn profile, Taneja, 45, joined PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited (PwC) as Assistant Manager in 1999. He worked at the company for nearly 17 years (from July 1999 to March 2016) before joining SolarCity Corporation.
Journey at Tesla
Taneja managed multiple finance and accounting roles from March 2016 at SolarCity Corporation, a solar panel developing company acquired by [Tesla](https://www.gqindia.com/get-smart/content/tesla-model-s-plaid-to-pininfirina-battista-fastest-electric-cars-in-the-world) in 2016. He also served as Tesla's Assistant Corporate Controller between February 2017 and May 2018, and as Corporate Controller from May 2018 before being appointed as Chief Accounting Officer at Tesla in March 2019.
Net worth
According to _IndiaTV_ , Tesla's new CFO of Indian-origin (Vaibhav Taneja) has an estimated net worth of $52.1 million (approximately Rs 431 crore).
